snippet.title: Pao Pao – Official Demo Trailer | Steam
snippet.description:
Check out Pao Pao – a wild mix of culinary diving and animal madness. Here you become the ultimate restaurant boss and management guru! 

Learn more about Pao Pao: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3024130/Pao_Pao/

About ArtDock: 
ArtDock is an indie game development studio with a growing international presence. We focus on creating colorful, character-driven experiences that blend casual fun with creative mechanics. Our portfolio includes titles like Pao Pao, Penguin Helper and SOS OPS. As a team, we work closely to craft unique worlds for players on Steam and consoles.

For more info visit our website: / https://games.artdock.studio/
